lines.say: First, the truth. In August twenty twenty-five, famine was confirmed around Gaza City.
Israel disputed the method. But the hunger was real.
Then, in October: a ceasefire. And trucks.
By June, Israel counted one point seven eight million tons of food.
Flour, sugar, tomatoes? About sixty percent cheaper, says the UN's food agency.
Late twenty twenty-five: a hundred thousand Gazans at the famine level.
Hunger isn't over. One point two million still face crisis or worse.
And the food? A U.S. drone filmed suspected <<h|ɑ|ˈ|m|ɑ|s>> men looting an aid truck.
In July, the UN said gunmen of <<h|ɑ|ˈ|m|ɑ|s>>'s government stormed a food point.
So where is hunger worst right now?
Sudan. A hundred and thirty-five thousand at the famine level. And where does the world look?
Gazans deserve food. And better than <<h|ɑ|ˈ|m|ɑ|s>>.

caption_en:
Famine in Gaza. Watch. 🍞

The hunger was real: on 22 Aug 2025 the IPC (Integrated Food Security Phase Classification) confirmed famine in Gaza Governorate. Israel rejected the method.

After the 10 Oct 2025 ceasefire, COGAT (Coordination of Government Activities in the Territories) counts 1.78M tons of food in, Oct 2025 to Jun 2026 (Jul 2026). UN-tracked figures are lower.

Prices per kg, early Oct 2025 to late Mar 2026 (WFP Market Monitor): flour 7.20 to 2.80 NIS, sugar 12 to 5, tomatoes 55 to 19. Flour was still 47% above pre-war.

Famine level (IPC Phase 5): 104,000 in Oct to Nov 2025 (IPC, Dec 2025). Apr to Jun 2026: none. But 1.2M (59%) still faced crisis or worse, projected 1.4M (67%) by Dec (IPC, Jul 2026).

31 Oct 2025: the U.S.-led Civil-Military Coordination Center (CMCC) said a drone saw suspected HAMAS operatives loot an aid truck (CENTCOM). 13 Jul 2026: UN official Ramiz Alakbarov said gunmen of Gaza's de facto authorities forced their way into a Jabalia food point: "These incidents are not isolated." HAMAS denies it (Reuters).

Famine level | crisis or worse, 2026: Sudan 135,000 | 2 in 5 (IPC, May). South Sudan 73,300 | 56% (IPC, Apr). Yemen about 41,000 projected | over half (Global Report on Food Crises). Gaza 0 | 59% (IPC, Jul). Haiti no data | 52% (IPC, Apr). North Korea: no IPC data. Gaza's crisis share is still among the highest.

Photos: Eliran t (CC BY-SA 4.0); Ashraf Amra (CC BY-SA 3.0 IGO); U.S. Army (public domain); via Wikimedia Commons. AI voice.

Gazans deserve food, and better than HAMAS. Send this to someone.
caption_he:
רעב בעזה. תראו.
הרעב היה אמיתי: באוגוסט 2025 ה־IPC (סיווג שלבי ביטחון תזונתי) הכריז על רעב באזור העיר עזה. ישראל חלקה על השיטה.
אחרי הפסקת האש: כ־1.78 מיליון טון מזון עד יוני 2026 (מתפ"ש). קמח, סוכר ועגבניות זולים בכ־60% (WFP, מרץ 2026).
ברמת רעב (שלב 5): 104,000 בסוף 2025. ביולי 2026: אפס. אבל 1.2 מיליון עדיין במשבר או גרוע מזה.
ובינתיים: חשד לביזת משאית סיוע בידי חמאס (פיקוד המרכז האמריקאי, אוקטובר 2025), והאו"ם מאשים אנשים מטעם שלטון חמאס בפריצה לנקודת חלוקת מזון (יולי 2026). חמאס מכחיש.
סודאן: 135,000 ברמת רעב. ולאן העולם מסתכל?
לתושבי עזה מגיע אוכל, ומגיע להם יותר מחמאס.
